candidates.requirement: Call json_tokener_parse_ex repeatedly on the same tokener with successive chunks of a number so the retained number state is reconstructed.
candidates.target_route: Create a tokener; pass [0, then e+, then 1] as three successive parse_ex calls; release any result and free the tokener.
candidates.failure_condition: The old entry always creates a fresh tokener and makes one parse_ex call, so the changed nonempty-buffer reconstruction is unreachable for every generated input.
candidates.alternative_paths: A single input cannot retain a prior chunk: entry into a new number resets the buffer, and exhausting a chunk returns from parse_ex. No other call occurs before cleanup.
